pinTitle: Partner prioritizes ex's child over yours: boundary issue or compatibility problem
pinDescription: If your partner drives hours for his ex's child but won't make space for yours, you're facing a painful double standard. This guide walks through how to tell whether it's a boundary issue that can be addressed or a deeper compatibility problem. See the full breakdown and what to do next on the site.
